author: EmuCore - Hub
title: 2️⃣PLAYSTATION 2 Emulation on a BUDGET // MANGMI Air X - Settings, Guide, & 50+ Game Showcase!
summary: Retro Tech Dad stress-tests the sub-$90 Mangmi Air X and Snapdragon 662 with more than fifty PS2 games, pairing a NetherSX2 configuration guide with per-game evidence that shows where a budget handheld needs compromises.

blocks.text: The review identifies an unusually constrained target: a 5.5-inch 1080p handheld built around Snapdragon 662. Setup, default controls and per-game settings precede two alphabetical game passes covering racers, fighters, platformers, RPGs and demanding titles such as Burnout 3, Jak & Daxter and Shadow of the Colossus. That breadth makes the chapter list more useful than a claim that the device “supports PS2.” It reveals which workloads were chosen, where tuning entered, and how a low price changes expectations.

Mangmi supplied the unit, and purchase links generate affiliate revenue, although the creator says the company did not review the video. The test uses a specific NetherSX2 build and community patches; later software, ambient temperature and silicon variation can shift results. More than fifty short samples still do not prove completion, correct effects or stable frame pacing. Compare the exact settings and difficult scenes, treat patches as title-specific, and verify current price, controls, battery and return policy before interpreting the showcase as buying advice.
